name: prd-workflow
description: Epic → PRD → issues → TDD implement → finalize workflow. Epic decomposition, feature & capability PRD authoring, adopting legacy PRDs by backfilling frontmatter, vertical-slice issue breakdown with native sub-issues + dependencies (GitHub/Forgejo, or a built-in local tracker for non-git projects), test-plan grilling, slices integrated on a shared PRD branch with one PR + CI gate per PRD (not per slice), and knowledge harvest. Project-agnostic via an optional docs/prd/profile.md.
